traits.name: Vulnerable to Sunlight
traits.text: A dero stalker takes 4 damage for every hour they're exposed to sunlight.

traits.name: Nimble Dodge
traits.text: ⬲ Requirements The dero stalker is not encumbered. Trigger A creature targets the dero with an attack and the dero can see the attacker. Effect The dero dodges out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
